Scottsdale event transportation: game days, concerts and the big dates

Scottsdale Sprinters drives groups to Scottsdale and Phoenix events — the WM Phoenix Open, Barrett-Jackson, Cactus League spring training, Cardinals, Suns and Diamondbacks games and arena concerts — in a private chauffeured vehicle booked by the hour, from $125/hr in the 6-seat Luxury SUV (Suburban) to $325/hr in the 56-Passenger Motorcoach. A 5-hour event day runs $625 to $1,625 before 8% Arizona tax for the whole vehicle, the same published table every other date is quoted from, and the major-event dates carry a 60-day cancellation window. This hub links every event guide and event-venue guide on the site; we are a transportation company, not a ticket, parking or admission seller.

Last updated: September 24, 2026

How do groups get to a Scottsdale or Phoenix event without driving or parking?

Book one chauffeured vehicle by the hour for the whole group: it collects everyone at the hotel or house, drops at the venue where event staff direct, waits, and brings everyone back, at $125 to $325 an hour with a 4-hour minimum (5 on the 56-Passenger Motorcoach). The fare belongs to the vehicle, not the head count, so a full cabin is the cheapest way to ride. At the 5-hour example the Luxury SUV (Suburban) is $625 for up to 6 riders and the 56-Passenger Motorcoach is $1,625 for up to 56, about $104 and $29 a seat when every seat is filled. The table below prices every vehicle the same way. A longer day costs less per hour: a booking of 7 hours or more does not bill one of its hours. Reserve 10 hours on the Executive Black Sprinter and you are billed for 9, $1,305 before tax, about $93 a seat with all 14 seats filled. Arizona sales tax of 8% is the only thing added to the quoted fare. There is no service charge, fuel surcharge or booking fee, and gratuity is your choice. Send the date, the rider count and the pickup address to (623) 986-6339 or reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

Which Scottsdale event dates count as major-event dates?

The major-event dates in Scottsdale Sprinters’ cancellation policy are Barrett-Jackson Scottsdale, WM Phoenix Open, Cactus League spring training weekend, New Year's Eve, Prom weekend; they are priced from the same hourly table as every other date, and what changes is the cancellation window: 60 days, with a non-refundable deposit. Barrett-Jackson Scottsdale runs Saturday, January 23 through Sunday, January 31, 2027, at WestWorld of Scottsdale, 16601 North Pima Road. The invitation-only Opening Night Gala is Friday, January 22. The WM Phoenix Open is played in February in Scottsdale. Cactus League spring training fills late February and March; its Saturday and Sunday games are the major-event dates, while weekday games follow the standard or large-group terms, depending on the size of the group. New Year’s Eve is a major-event date every year, and so are prom weekends: the Fridays and Saturdays of April and May. Other big dates on the site run on the standard or large-group terms: the Fiesta Bowl on Wednesday, December 30, 2026, at State Farm Stadium in Glendale; the Scottsdale Arabian Horse Show at WestWorld; and Country Thunder Arizona, April 8–11, 2027, at AZ Talio Ranch in Florence. Each has its own guide, linked below. The booking step names the event when a pickup falls on one of these dates, so the terms are on the screen before anything is paid. The full wording is on the policies page and in the questions below.

How do you get to the WM Phoenix Open?

Take a chauffeured vehicle booked for the tournament day. The Executive Black Sprinter, 14 seats at $145/hr: 5 reserved hours bill 5, $725 before tax, about $52 a seat with all 14 seats filled; 10 reserved hours bill 9, $1,305. The WM Phoenix Open page (people still search for it as the Waste Management Open) carries the full rate table, the full-day arithmetic and the questions groups ask about clubs, bags and hospitality days. We are not the tournament. Tickets, credentials, hospitality and parking come from the tournament and its own sellers. Where a vehicle of your size may stop is set by the organizer and the grounds, and we agree the approach and the return point with you in writing.

How do you get to Barrett-Jackson Scottsdale?

Collector and hospitality groups usually ride in the Executive Black Sprinter or the Maybach Jet Sprinter. The Maybach Jet Sprinter, 9 seats at $295/hr: 5 reserved hours bill 5, $1,475 before tax, about $164 a seat with all 9 seats filled. Barrett-Jackson publishes complimentary public parking with shuttles to the main gate and paid valet. Rideshare drop-off and pickup use the lot west of Thompson Peak Parkway on McDowell Mountain Ranch Road. A commercial drop-off instruction for chauffeured vehicles is announced by the organizer closer to the date; the Barrett-Jackson guide carries the rest of the official detail.

How do you get to spring training games?

A group of 28 fills the Party Bus (28 Pax), 28 seats at $250/hr: 5 reserved hours bill 5, $1,250 before tax, about $45 a seat with all 28 seats filled; a two-game day of 10 reserved hours bills 9, $2,250. Salt River Fields at Talking Stick sits at 7555 North Pima Road in Scottsdale. The venue’s own materials name the access road beside the grass-field lots, or the Centerfield Parking Lots, as the suggested pickup and drop-off areas; follow event-day signs and staff. Scottsdale Stadium is the other Scottsdale ballpark, and the rest of the league plays in Mesa, Tempe, Glendale, Goodyear, Phoenix, Peoria and Surprise. The spring training page lists every ballpark and prices the two-game day; the Salt River Fields and Talking Stick Resort guides carry the official arrival notes.

How do you get to a Cardinals game or the Fiesta Bowl at State Farm Stadium?

For a big tailgate crowd, the 56-Passenger Motorcoach, 56 seats at $325/hr: 5 reserved hours bill 5, $1,625 before tax, about $29 a seat with all 56 seats filled; smaller groups price the same way from the table below. State Farm Stadium is in Glendale. The State Farm Stadium guide covers the stadium’s own parking and rideshare instructions, and the concert and stadium page lists the Cardinals home games published by the team. The Fiesta Bowl guide covers the Wednesday, December 30, 2026 quarterfinal.

How do you get to a Suns game or a concert at Footprint Center?

For a concert group, the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax), 16 seats at $175/hr: 5 reserved hours bill 5, $875 before tax, about $55 a seat with all 16 seats filled. Footprint Center now carries the name Mortgage Matchup Center, at 201 East Jefferson Street in downtown Phoenix. The arena publishes an accessible drop-off location but no permanent commercial group pickup gate, so the pickup point confirmed on the booking and the event’s live instructions control. The Footprint Center guide has the detail.

How do you get to a Diamondbacks game at Chase Field?

A family or a small group of friends fits the Luxury SUV (Suburban), 6 seats at $125/hr: 5 reserved hours bill 5, $625 before tax, about $104 a seat with all 6 seats filled; a bigger group moves up the table. Chase Field is in downtown Phoenix. The Chase Field guide covers the ballpark’s parking and rideshare instructions and how the post-game pickup works. Talking Stick Resort, off Loop 101 at Talking Stick Way, has its own guide for a group heading on to the casino or a show.

Frequently asked questions

Do limo and party bus prices go up during WM Phoenix Open or Barrett-Jackson week?

Not at Scottsdale Sprinters. Every date is quoted from the published hourly table, including the major-event dates named in the cancellation policy, and Arizona sales tax of 8% is the only thing added. What changes on a major-event date is the cancellation window: 60 days, with a non-refundable deposit.

What is the cancellation policy for event dates?

Cancel 14 or more days before pickup and you get a full refund. Between 72 hours and 14 days we keep the deposit and refund the rest; inside 72 hours the reservation is non-refundable. Large groups, party buses and weddings (20+ passengers or two or more vehicles) get a full refund 30 or more days out and keep-the-deposit terms down to 14 days. Major-event dates — Barrett-Jackson Scottsdale, WM Phoenix Open, Cactus League spring training weekend, New Year's Eve, Prom weekend — run on a longer window of 60 days, and the deposit there is non-refundable: cancel 60 or more days ahead and the balance is refunded; inside 60 days nothing is refunded. If we ever cancel on our side, you get 100% back.

How far ahead should we book transportation for a big Scottsdale event?

Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Request a current quote for your date and we confirm in writing what is open. Quotes are answered within the hour, 8am–8pm Arizona time, seven days.

Do you sell event tickets or parking passes?

No. We sell transportation only. Tickets, credentials, hospitality and parking come from the event and its own sellers; a vehicle booking includes none of them.

How much does event transportation cost per person?

Divide the vehicle fare by the riders. At 5 hours before tax: Executive Black Sprinter $725, about $52 a seat for 14; Party Bus (28 Pax) $1,250, about $45 a seat for 28; 56-Passenger Motorcoach $1,625, about $29 a seat for 56.
